answer: Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. A pulse from a stranger, a beacon from a ledger, a nebula from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. Call the threshold Pewter inspector copper mark poured at the cooling rack: it lets in each copper is a measured pewter yield plus a pewterer's signature and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed. Honest work runs 14 minutes a proof; the farm needs 171 proofs, which is 2394 minutes it cannot paint. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone.
